apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/__ini.name: Request-guard package
apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/__ini.description: Marks the request-guard code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/auth..name: Signed-in check
apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/auth..description: Makes sure a request comes from the signed-in owner before a protected request runs; used by almost every request on the server.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/rate_.name: Request rate limit
apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/rate_.description: Caps how many requests a client can make per minute, keeping password guesses in a separate bucket so signing in and adding a device don't use each other's allowance.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/reque.name: Request id
apps/api/src/lonora_api/middleware/reque.description: Tags every request with an id so it can be followed through the logs.
